title: 4 Queen Mary Postcards Long Beach CA Mike Roberts B2164 B2174 B2175 B2188
conditionDescription: All four unposted and unwritten. Deckle edges, light toning on the backs; B2174 has a small soft corner at the top left. See photos.
descriptionText:
Four Official Queen Mary Souvenir postcards, City of Long Beach, California. Published by Mike Roberts, Berkeley ("the Continental card"), circa 1970s.

You get:
- B2164 - "Queen Mary Dockside", dockside in all her elegance with her famous three funnels in prominent view (distributed by Mitock & Sons, North Hollywood)
- B2174 - the Queen Mary's clean white side and famous three stacks, looking down the row of portside lifeboats toward the docking bridge
- B2175 - the Queen Mary's stern with sunset reflecting off the portside, tour boarding ramps at left, propeller housing at the water line
- B2188 - the Queen Mary being moved to her new home at Pier J, Long Beach skyline in the background (color photo: Tom Witherspoon)

All four unposted and blank on the back. Deckle (scalloped) edges, light toning on the backs. See photos.

Ships flat with a stiffener in a protective mailer.
